The problem states that for every pound of beeswax, Charlie can make 10 candles. To make 20 candles, he needs 2 pounds of beeswax. The cost per pound (including wicks) is $10, so total supplies cost is $20. Selling 20 candles at $2 each gives $40 in revenue. The net profit is $40 - $20 = $20.

Answer: 20
reasoning: We need to find net profit. Given: For every pound of beeswax, he can make 10 tapered candles. So 20 candles require 2 pounds of beeswax. One pound of beeswax and wicks cost $10.00. So 2 pounds cost $20.00. He sells each candle for $2.00, so 20 candles sell for $40.00. Net profit = revenue - cost = $40 - $20 = $20. So answer is 20.
